name: Burst Hammer
description: Casts this skill and generates 3 consecutive waves of explosions in a circular area in front, dealing Attack Physical Damage equal to 64% of Base Damage on hit. If you have at least 1 stack of Tenacity Blessing, this skill consumes 1 stack of Tenacity Blessing to deal additional damage.
Burst Hammer:
Deals Attack Physical Damage equal to 64% of Base Damage
If the summoner has Tenacity Blessing stacks when casting this skill, consumes 1 stack of Tenacity Blessing to make this cast deal +30% additional damage
The pummel and explosion caused by this skill can hit the same enemy.
This skill's Shotgun Effect falloff coefficient is 64%

name: Charged Pummel
description: Pummels the ground at the end of the skill channeling, dealing 438% Weapon Attack Damage.

The skill will generate an Electric Field at the spot pummeled when consuming Demolisher Charge, continuously hitting the enemies within the field for a period of time and dealing 22% Weapon Attack Damage.
When consumingDemolisher Charge, Each channeled stack additionally increases the Damage of the Pummel cast that time and extends the Base Duration of the Electric Field.
All of the skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Lightning Damage.
Pummel:
Deals 438% Weapon Attack Damage.
When consuming Demolisher Charge, 70% additional Hit Damage for the Pummel per channeled stacks.
Electric Field:
Deals 22% Weapon Attack Damage.
The Electric Field lasts 2s.
Each channeled stack grants +0.2s Electric Field Duration.
The Electric Field deals damage once every 0.3s
Converts 100% of the skill's Physical Damage to Lightning Damage
+100% additional Attack Speed for this skill
The skill gains Demolisher Charge once every 3s.
Max channeled stacks: 5
Movement is not restricted when the skill is being channeled

name: Corrosive Shot
description: Casts the skill and tosses a Corrosive Shot, which explodes upon contacting the target, dealing 95% Weapon Attack Damage.

The Corrosive Shot also generates a Corrosion Terra if it contacts the target before splitting, dealing 57 Persistent Erosion Damage every second to enemies on it and additionally increasing the damage enemies take from this skill while on it.
This skill deals increased Wilt Damage.
All of the skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Erosion Damage.
Explosion:
Deals 95% Weapon Attack Damage.
+30% chance to Wilt
+30% additional Wilt Damage for this skill
Converts 100% of the skill's Physical Damage to Erosion Damage
Corrosion Terra:
Corrosion Terra lasts for 3s.
Deals 57 Persistent Erosion Damage every second for 2s.
Damage Over Time statuses inflicted by the skill can't be spread (excludes Ailments)
Terra Charge cannot be consumed until the Terra Charge of this skill is full
The maximum stack of Terra Charge is 1.

name: Flame Slash
description: Launches a Sweep Slash to attack the fan-shaped area in front, dealing 346% Weapon Attack Damage on hit.

This skill is affected by Steep Strike chance and may be cast in Steep Strike form. When it launches a Steep Strike, it generates 3 flames, dealing 346% Weapon Attack Damage on hit. The Skill Area will increase the number of flames generated by a Steep Strike. Multiple flames can hit the same enemy at once.
All of the skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Fire Damage.
Sweep Slash:
Deals 346% Weapon Attack Damage.
Steep Strike:
Deals 346% Weapon Attack Damage.
For every 115% Area bonus for this skill, the number of fire torrents +2.
For every 115% Area bonus for this skill, the distance of fire torrents +30%.
The damage from multiple fire torrents can be stacked.
This skill's Shotgun Effect falloff coefficient is 50%
Converts 100% of the skill's Physical Damage to Fire Damage
This skill +20% Steep Strike chance.

name: Frost Terra
description: Casts this skill to generate a Frost Terra at the target spot, dealing 484 Persistent Cold Damage every second.
Terra Charge additionally increases this skill's damage.
Frost Terra:
Frost Terra lasts for 6s
Deals 484 Persistent Cold damage every second for 2s.
Inflicts Frostbite when this skill deals damage
For each Terra Charge consumed when this skill is cast, that cast deals 26% additional damage
Damage Over Time statuses inflicted by the skill can't be spread (excludes Ailments)
The maximum stacks of Terra Charge are 1
Gain 1 stack of Terra Charge per 0.5s
This skill's max base Terra quantity is 1.

+26% additional damage for the skill for every Terra Charge consumed

name: Ghost Blade Einherjar
description: Casts the skill and places 1 Ghost Blade Sentry, who will throw a Ghost Blade at 1 enemy within its range, dealing 93% Weapon Attack Damage on hit.
The Sentry can Multistrike. Upon reaching the max Multistrike Count, this attack causes an explosion and deals 185% Weapon Attack Damage on hit.
The number of Sentries placed grants Multistrike damage.
All of the skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Erosion Damage.
Ghost Blade Einherjar:
Base Sentry Cast Frequency is 100% of average Weapon Attack Speed.
The Sentry lasts 8s.
Skill's max base Sentry quantity is 1
+100% Multistrike chance for the Sentry/Sentries placed by this skill
Sentries placed by this skill can Multistrike
Multistrikes deal 15% increasing damage for every 1 Sentry(ies) deployed by this skill
Sentries placed by this skill can only attack again 1 s after launching a Multistrike
The interval is affected by Sentry Cast Frequency bonus
The skill fires 1 Projectile in its base state.
Projectile Quantity bonuses also apply to Target Quantity.
Ghost Blade:
Deals 93% Weapon Attack Damage.
Projectiles fired by the skill are not affected by Projectile Quantity bonuses.
Explosion:
Deals 185% Weapon Attack Damage.
Converts 100% of the Physical Damage dealt by the Sentries placed by this skill to Erosion Damage

name: Hammer of Ash
description: Casts the skill and pummels the ground in front, dealing 369% Weapon Attack Damage on hit.
When pummeling, generates 3 auto-tracing Ember Projectiles, dealing 369% Weapon Attack Damage on hit.
When the skill consumes Demolisher Charge, Embers cause explosion on hit, dealing 369% Weapon Attack Damage.
Demolisher Charge additionally increases the skill's damage.
All of the skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Fire Damage.
Pummel:
Deals 369% Weapon Attack Damage.
Ember Projectile:
Deals 369% Weapon Attack Damage.
The skill fires 1 Projectile in its base state.
Projectile Quantity of this skill +2
Projectiles fired by this skill cannot Penetrate, Jump, or Return
Explosion:

The skill gains Demolisher Charge once every 3s.
+215% additional Hit Damage when the skill consumes Demolisher Charge
Converts 100% of the skill's Physical Damage to Fire Damage
The pummel and explosion caused by the skill can hit the same enemy.
The skill's Shotgun Effect falloff coefficient is 70%.

name: Icy Blade
description: Launches a Sweep Slash to attack the fan-shaped area in front, dealing 142% Weapon Attack Damage on hit.

This skill is affected by Steep Strike chance and may be cast in Steep Strike form. When it launches a Steep Strike, it generates 1 Icy Blade, dealing 142% Weapon Attack Damage on hit. Upon hitting a Frozen enemy with this skill, gains a Steep Strike attempt. Causes an explosion when Steep Strike hits a Frozen enemy, dealing 213% Weapon Attack Damage. Multiple explosions and Steep Strikes can hit the same enemy.
All of this skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Cold Damage.

name: Inexhaustible Barrage
description: At the end of the channeling of the skill, drops multiple waves of barrage at enemies within a certain area, attacking random enemies within range, with each wave dealing 105% Weapon Attack Damage.
The channeled stacks will increase the number of barrage waves.
Projectile Speed will additionally increase the skill's damage.
Inexhaustible Barrage:
Deals 105% Weapon Attack Damage.
The skill drops 1 wave of barrage in its base state.
Each wave of barrage fires 1 Projectile by default.
Each channeled stack will grant a wave of barrage at the end of the channeling process.
Projectile Quantity of this skill +5
25% of bonuses to Projectile Speed for this skill (up to 200% ) also apply to this skill's additional damage
+100% additional Attack Speed for this skill
Movement is not restricted when the skill is being channeled.
Channels up to 5 stacks.

name: Lightning Beam
description: Casts the skill and fires 1 Lightning Beam forward at enemies within the Beam Area in front, dealing 25-480 Spell Lightning Damage on hit.
Every 2 time(s) this skill is cast, generates a Thunderbolt around the caster that follows the caster and automatically casts this skill at enemies within a certain area.
The Thunderbolt lasts for 6s. Up to 3 Thunderbolt(s) can be generated.
Lightning Beam:
Deals 25-480 Spell Lightning Damage
Every 2 time(s) this skill is cast, generates a Thunderbolt around the caster that follows the caster
This skill generates up to 3 Thunderbolt(s)
The Thunderbolts last for 6s
For every +1 Beam(s), increases this skill's Thunderbolt generation upper limit by +1
The number of Beams generated by this skill is not affected by Quantity bonuses
The Beams fired by this skill are not affected by Beam Length bonuses
100% of the bonuses and additional bonuses for the skill's Beam Length is also applied to the skill's Skill Area
No more Thunderbolts will be generated after reaching the upper limit.
For every +1 Beam(s), increases this skill's Thunderbolt generation upper limit by +1
100% of the bonuses and additional bonuses for the skill's Beam Length is also applied to the skill's Skill Area

When the Marked Arrow marks the enemy or hits a Marked enemy, channels down 5 Explosive Arrows around the enemy with each Explosive Arrow dealing 162% Weapon Attack Damage.
Marked Arrow:
Deals 35% Weapon Attack Damage.
The skill fires 1 Projectile in its base state.
+100% chance for the Marked Arrows to Mark the enemy on hit
The Projectile is not affected by Projectile Quantity bonuses.
Projectiles fired by this skill cannot Jump or Penetrate
Explosive Arrow:
Deals 162% Weapon Attack Damage.
The skill fires 1 Projectile in its base state.
Projectile Quantity of this skill +4
Converts 100% of the skill's Physical Damage to Fire Damage
The Explosive Arrows fired by the skill can hit the same enemy.
The skill's Shotgun Effect falloff coefficient is 70%.

name: Mind Control
description: When channeling the skill, links to multiple enemies within a certain area, dealing 519 Persistent Erosion Damage per second to them.
Each link of the skill restores 1/2% Max Life every second.
Movement is not restricted when the skill is being channeled.
Max channeled stacks can grant additional damage to the skill and increase the number of the links.
Link:
Deals 519 Persistent Erosion Damage every second
Damage Over Time effect lasts 2s
Initially has 3 maximum links
+1 maximum link for every channeled stack
This skill 21.5 % additional damage for every +1 additional Max Channeled Stack(s)
-30% Movement Speed while channeling this skill
0.5% Max Life per second per link
Channels up to 5 stacks.

name: Psionic Missile
description: Casts this skill to fire 1 projectile traveling in an arc, exploding upon landing to deal 629-1048 Spell Physical Damage

The first projectile explodes at the targeted location, while remaining projectiles are randomly distributed within a certain area around the targeted location. The farther the targeted distance, the smaller the distribution area, and vice versa
Multiple projectiles can hit the same enemy. This skill's Shotgun Effect falloff coefficient is 80%

name: Ring of Blades
description: When channeling this skill, generates ring blades around you, dealing 379-631 Spell Physical Damage to enemies within range.
The ring blades will remain for 5s after the channeling is over.
Movement is not restricted when this skill is being channeled.
Ring of Blades:
Deals 379-631 Spell Physical Damage
For the same enemy, Projectiles can deal damage once every 0.25s at the fastest
Max channeled stacks: 5
Generates 1 Projectile for each channeling, up to 5 Projectile(s)
After channeling, Projectiles will remain for 5s
Movement is not restricted when the skill is being channeled
This skill 21.5 % additional damage for every +1 additional Max Channeled Stack(s)
-30% Movement Speed while channeling this skill
The orbiting radius of Projectiles is also affected by the skill's Skill Area bonuses.
This skill is not affected by Projectile Size

name: Savage Charge
description: When channeling the skill, charges forward, passing through the enemies while moving, dealing 57% Weapon Attack Damage continuously, and knocking them back.

If the channeling of this skill stops at max channeled stacks, a Savage Strike will be launched, dealing 570% Weapon Attack Damage to the enemies in front and knocking them back. Demolisher Charge additionally increases this attack's damage.
Channeled stacks will increase the Skill Area of the skill when the character is charging using this skill.
Charge:
Deals 57% Weapon Attack Damage.
Savage Strike:
Deals 570% Weapon Attack Damage.
When consuming Demolisher Charge, this skill deals +90% additional Hit Damage.
On hit, the skill knocks back the enemy.
+100% additional Attack Speed for this skill
The skill gains Demolisher Charge once every 3s.
Max channeled stacks: 5.
+12% Skill Area per channeled stack
The character will be forced to move forward when channeling the skill.
You can pass through enemies while channeling this skill

name: Shackles of Malice
description: Casts the skill and fires a Malice Chain, dealing 667-667 Spell Erosion Damage. The chain Jumps 2 time(s).
Upon hitting a Cursed enemy, the chain causes an explosion and deals 667-667 Spell Erosion Damage to enemies within a certain area, then it removes all Curse Effects from the Cursed enemy.
The explosion deals more damage to enemies that are inflicted with more Curse Effects.
Malice Chain:
Deals 667-667 Spell Erosion Damage
Explosion:
Deals 667-667 Spell Erosion Damage
The explosion removes all Curse Effects from the enemy hit by the chain
For every 1 Curse Effect inflicted on the enemy hit by the chain, the explosion 25% additional Hit Damage (multiplies)

name: Shadow Swamp
description: Casts the skill and generates Erosion Explosion at the target spot, dealing 401-401 Spell Erosion Damage to enemies within a certain area.
The Erosion Explosion will leave a Swamp Terra afterwards, dealing 546 Persistent Erosion Damage to enemies in it. The Swamp Terra lasts 6s.
The Swamp Terra can be moved by Shadows. After that, there will be another Erosion Explosion and the duration will be refreshed.
Explosion:
Deals 401-401 Spell Erosion Damage.
Swamp Terra:
Swamp Terra lasts for 6s
Deals 546 Persistent Erosion Damage every second for 2s
The skill can only generate 1 Terra
Enemies on a Swamp Terra are Weakened
On hit, Shadow Shot moves the existing Swamp Terra to the location of the hit and causes another explosion
Each movement grants +10% additional Skill Area for the Swamp Terra
Stacks up to 1 time(s)
For every stack of Terra Charge consumed, the Swamp Terra gains an additional effect every time it moves: +26% additional Damage Over Time (does not apply to Ailment Damage)
Damage Over Time statuses inflicted by the skill can't be spread (excludes Ailments)
The maximum stacks of Terra Charge are 1
Gain 1 stack of Terra Charge per 0.5s

Shadow Swamp: Erosion Spell Skill. Conjures a Shadow Swamp at the target location to deal damage and Weaken enemies. Shadow Swamp can be moved with Shadow Shot. Each time it is moved, its damage and Area will be additionally increased.
Conviction: The adversities you carry are sins that you can never escape from.

name: Speed Phantom
description: Casts the skill and moves in the target direction, leaving behind a Remnant before and after moving, and inflicting Reversed Knockback on nearby enemies within a certain distance.
The Remnant explodes after 0.65s, dealing damage to enemies once. Gains 1 stack of Euphoria for each enemy hit:
For every 1 stack(s) of Euphoria, 2.5% additional Spell Damage, up to 8 stacks, lasting for 1.2s.
Remnant:
Remnant lasts 0.65s.
You can have up to 2 Remnant(s).
Remnant explosions deal 542-904 Spell Physical Damage on hit.
Gains 1 stack of Euphoria for each enemy hit by a Remnant explosion.
Euphoria:
For every 1 stack(s) of Euphoria, 2.5% additional Spell Damage, up to 8 stacks, lasting for 1.2s
Gains 1 stack of buff for each enemy hit with this skill, stacking up to 8 times
Knockback effect from this skill is reversed

name: Star Stalker
description: Casts the skill and fires 1 Projectile forward. The Projectile will generate an area that follows itself. While inside this area, the character gains Euphoria: +32% additional Damage Over Time.
The Projectile will continuously track Elites and attach itself to the tracked target upon reaching it. After this unit is defeated, the Projectile will track another unit.
The Projectile flies with a 100% of the Character's Movement Speed, and lasts for 4s.
Star Stalker:
While inside the area, the character gains Euphoria:
+32% additional Damage Over Time
The Flying Speed of the Projectile is 100% of the character's Movement Speed
The Projectile lasts for 4s
The Projectiles launched by this skill are not affected by Penetrate, Jump, or Return effects

description: Casts this skill and generates a Thornfield at the target location, dealing 405 Persistent Physical Damage every second.
Max Life additionally increases this skill's damage
While this skill's Terra lasts, you take True Damage equal to 20% of your Max Life every second
Thornfield:
Thornfield lasts 6s
Deals 405 Persistent Physical Damage every second for 2s
1.25% additional damage for this skill for every 100 Max Life, up to +100%

Damage Over Time statuses inflicted by the skill can't be spread (excludes Ailments)
You take True Damage equal to 20% of Max Life and Energy Shield every second while this skill's Terra is active
The maximum stacks of Terra Charge are 1
Gain 1 stack of Terra Charge per 0.5s
This skill's max base Terra quantity is 1.

All of the skill's Physical Damage will be converted to Lightning Damage.
Thunder Spike:
Deals 277% Weapon Attack Damage.

100% of the increase or decrease on Skill Area is also applied to the Tracking Area of this skill's Shadows, up to 100%

name: Whirlwind Blade
description: Casts the skill and fires 1 Projectile that always Penetrates in the target direction, dealing 400-667 Spell Physical Damage. The Projectile deals damage once every 0.25s and stops on the spot after traveling a fixed distance or hitting an Elite.
After casting this skill, casting it again will recall the Projectile that has been fired, but that cast is not deemed to have been cast again.

Projectiles can only be fired again after all previous Projectiles have been recalled. Projectiles will be automatically recalled after 5s. If a Projectile is more than 40m away from the character, the Projectile will be forcibly removed and won't need to be recalled.
The Projectiles fired by this skill can hit the same enemy.
Whirlwind Blade:
Deals 400-667 Spell Physical Damage.
This skill fires 1 Projectile in its base state.
It deals damage once every 0.25s.
Projectiles from this skill always Penetrate
Projectiles will be automatically recovered after 5 s.
The Projectiles shot by the skill can hit the same enemy.
The skill's Shotgun Effect falloff coefficient is 75%.

+9% additional Fire Damage
+15% chance to Ignite targets
Adds 2 - 2 Base Ignite Damage

This skill gains 15 Focus Pts when inflicting Ignite. Upon defeating an enemy, there is a 100% chance to consume 40 Focus Pts and trigger this skill on the enemy, dealing Secondary Fire Damage equal to 25% of their Max Life to enemies within 3m (not affected by bonuses).
Additionally increases this skill's area for each time Ignite has been inflicted recently.

+120% chance for the supported skill to trigger Multistrike

Multistrike: Attack Skills have a chance to trigger Multistrike, automatically using the same Attack Skill a certain number of times consecutively.

Using an Attack Skill may has a chance to trigger Multistrike, automatically using this Attack Skill a certain number of times consecutively. Multistrike will not be triggered again during a Multistrike.

During Multistrike, each skill used will consume Mana or Life, and Multistrike will be interrupted when Mana or Life is insufficient. Multistrike will also be interrupted by moving or using other skills that are not accompanied by any actions or that will interrupt other skills.
Mobility Skills, Channeled Skills, and skills used by Sentries cannot trigger Multistrike.
By default, Multistrikes gain +20%% Attack Speed.

Multistrike Chance is 0 by default. When the Multistrike Chance exceeds 100%, one additional attack is guaranteed to be performed after your initial attack, and each full 100% increment grants another additional attack. The excessive chance that is lower than 100% will be the chance of performing another additional attack after the additional attacks.

Each attack performed during Multistrike of the skill will receive additional damage bonus based on the Multistrike Damage Increment (the second attack receives the bonus once, the third attack receives the bonus twice, and so on).
Additional Multistrike Damage Increment affects the "Multistrike Damage Increment" stat: its value will be multiplied by (100% + Additional Increment percentage).

The Multistrike Count starts from 1 (E.g. When the Multistrike Chance is 200%, the number of Multistrikes triggered by Attack Skills will be in a cycle of 1, 2, 3...). The Max Multistrike Count depends on the Multistrike Chance.
